rules.title: Self-contained alpha authority
rules.normative: Open C Core 0.1 Alpha is defined by its own public release artifacts.

rules.title: Line and block comments
rules.normative: Line comments and block comments are skipped by lexing; unterminated block comments produce OC-LEX-002.

rules.title: Unterminated string-like lexical sequence
rules.normative: A double quote not closed before line-feed or end of source produces OC-LEX-001.

rules.title: Fixed main entry point
rules.normative: A program must have the entry-point shape int main(void) block.

rules.title: Declaration and default initialization
rules.normative: A local int declaration introduces a visible binding; absent initializer binds 0.

rules.title: Same-scope duplicate rejection
rules.normative: A name may not be declared twice in one block scope; violation produces OC-STA-001.

rules.title: Unresolved local rejection
rules.normative: Every variable use and assignment target must resolve to a visible local variable; violation produces OC-STA-002.

rules.title: Nested block shadowing
rules.normative: An inner block may shadow an outer local variable without changing the outer binding after the inner block ends.

rules.title: Expression precedence
rules.normative: Multiplicative operators bind tighter than additive operators; precedence then follows relational, equality, logical-and, logical-or.

rules.title: If statement
rules.normative: if selects the then statement for nonzero condition and the else statement, if present, for zero condition.

rules.title: While statement
rules.normative: while repeats while its condition is nonzero.

rules.title: Division and remainder by zero trap
rules.normative: Division or remainder by zero traps with OC-TRAP-001.

rules.title: Syntax failure classification
rules.normative: Failure to match the alpha grammar produces OC-SYN-001.
